scores.label: A
scores.note: 4 plead, 5 beg, 8 petition and 9 call need 'for' and are ungrammatical in place (beg is also the wrong tone); 7 entreat takes a person as object; 10 urge means advocate, not ask for oneself

scores.label: B
scores.note: 3 seeking, 4 pleading, 5 sought, 8 pleaded, 9 solicited are the wrong verb form after 'could'; 6 beg needs 'for' and is the wrong tone; 7 cried is the wrong sense and form

scores.label: C
scores.note: 8 propose means suggest, not ask for; 10 assert is the wrong meaning
